scope: Linux/POSIX mmap and C11 malloc; toy fixed pool

claims.claim: mmap creates mappings, anonymous mapping is zero-initialized; MAP_SHARED and MAP_PRIVATE differ
claims.notes: Physical page allocation is often lazy, may vary

claims.claim: malloc manages allocator memory; brk/mmap policy and thresholds are implementation-dependent
Free blocks in fixed toy pool may sum to more than a request while no block is large enough
Mark-sweep reclaims unreachable objects, unlike pure reference counting which cannot collect cycles alone
